readme: Witch tuning. Edit the numbers, push, and the playable link rebuilds. Distances are metres, times seconds, angles degrees. What each knob does is in config/knobs/<section>.json, not in the tuning file (no notes there since 2026-10-28).
sections: The knobs come in sections (housekeeping, 2026-10-07): map, forest, witch, army, creatures, legends, party, view, light; each has its own file, config/knobs/<name>.json, which says what its knobs do.
